0 - No clear idea given
questions.targetEvidence: Creates a vivid story idea about a magical trip.

questions.prompt: If you could write a letter to an animal, what kind of animal would you write to?

1 - An unclear choice of animal

questions.prompt: Imagine you could create a festival. What would it celebrate and what would people do at your festival? Tell me your idea!

0 - No clear idea given

questions.prompt: What is your favorite season, and how would you celebrate it? Tell me your idea!
